facts: ES modules: the import-map key three can resolve to the pinned build/three.module.js URL. Addon modules import the bare specifier three internally, so it must resolve in the same document.

Standalone browser configuration: place an inline <script type="importmap"> containing a JSON object with an imports object in the document head before any module script. The official r160 core/addon configuration, using these verified pinned CDN URLs, is <script type="importmap">{"imports":{"three":"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js","three/addons/":"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/"}}</script>. With that declaration the OrbitControls named export is imported from the specifier three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js. This fragment configures dependency resolution only and is not a viewer implementation.

Import-map matching is exact unless both the key and mapped URL end with a slash. The exact key three maps only the name three; it does not map three/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js or any other subpath. The trailing-slash key three/addons/ above maps the remaining controls/OrbitControls.js suffix onto the pinned examples/jsm/ directory. An absolute URL import of OrbitControls is another supported form, but its internal bare three import still needs the core mapping.

OrbitControls is a named export of examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js, not a THREE namespace export from build/three.module.js. Its constructor takes a camera object and the renderer DOM element. It provides pointer orbit and wheel dolly/zoom; call update when damping is enabled.
MeshBasicMaterial has a wireframe boolean whose default is false. Match a visible checkbox initial state to the actual material state, and update the material property on change.
BoxGeometry extends BufferGeometry. The class WireframeGeometry accepts geometry; BufferGeometry/BoxGeometry do not expose computeWireframeGeometry().
A responsive perspective camera needs its aspect updated and updateProjectionMatrix() after viewport-size changes; renderer.setSize updates the drawing buffer.
